## How I tested

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated (required for changes under `Core`)
- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`): it decides the next version and the changelog
- [ ] Changes that remove data go through `SafetyGuard` / `Cleaner`
